user.title: Alarms & Reminders
user.description: Adds voice alarms and reminders. Change the settings and sounds afterwards with Configure.

abort.already_configured: Alarms & Reminders is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Alarms & Reminders is already set up.

data_description.default_satellite: Used when an alarm is set from a dashboard or the Assist dialog instead of a voice device.
data_description.ring_minutes: Alarms stop by themselves after this long if nobody stops them.
data_description.ramp_minutes: Wake-up alarms go from the starting volume to the alarm volume over this time. 0 = full volume straight away.
data_description.wake_lights: Leave empty to use the lights in the same room as the voice device.
data_description.light_ramp_minutes: Wake-up lights go from 1% to full brightness over this time. 0 = straight on.
data_description.notify_targets: Home Assistant app notify actions, e.g. notify.mobile_app_pixel. Used for reminders and ringing alarms.
data_description.notify_alarms: Shows a notification with Stop and Snooze buttons on the phones below while an alarm rings.

add_sound_file.title: Upload a sound
add_sound_file.description: MP3, WAV, OGG, FLAC or M4A. It's saved in Media › Local Media › alarms_reminders.

add_sound_link.title: Add a sound from a link
add_sound_link.description: A direct link to an audio file. YouTube and other video pages don't work: download the audio and upload it instead.

test_sound.title: Test a sound
test_sound.description: {played}Pick a sound and a voice device, then click Submit to play it once. To hear a whole alarm, with its room, sound and volume, press its Test button on the integration page.

error.bad_url: Enter a link starting with http:// or https://.
error.download_failed: The download failed. Check the link points straight to an audio file.
error.play_failed: Couldn't play it on that device. Check it's online.
error.not_loaded: Alarms & Reminders isn't running. Reload it and try again.

data_description.satellite: Where it rings or is spoken.
data_description.skip_next: Skips one day without deleting it. Skipped days: {skipped}
data_description.sound: Leave empty to use the default sound from the integration settings.
data_description.wake: Volume and lights ease up gradually.
data_description.lights: Lights to turn on. Leave empty to use your wake-up lights (or the lights in the device's room) for wake-up alarms.
